name: NCCW Southern Heritage Championship
epitaph: Won and lost twice across the promotion's own five-week run: the Crippler took it in the vacant first-card main event and lost it to Bobby "Bad Apple" Durango at the fed's first pay-per-view, and Durango was still champion when he folded it into the promotion's first double title two cards later.

name: NCCW Television Championship
epitaph: Created at the promotion's own first pay-per-view, where "Cajun" Huey Armstrong became its first champion; Bobby "Bad Apple" Durango won it from him ten days later in a winner-take-all match that also carried the Southern Heritage belt, becoming the fed's first double champion. A fellow Usenet participant's own later signature line names a different wrestler as the reigning, undefeated champion at the promotion's own fold, a claim no card in this record corroborates.

name: NCCW World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Decided at the promotion's own first pay-per-view, where "The Natural Wonder" Max Maxwell won a tournament final over the Mad Goat to become the fed's first-ever World Heavyweight Champion, successfully defending it against "Lucky" Lambert at the next and last card this record holds. A fellow Usenet participant's own signature line, five weeks later, names Bobby "Bad Apple" Durango as champion instead; no card documenting how the title changed hands survives.
